purpose: Bind the exact persisted benchmark scene and every construction/material metadata contract to the same real Unity capture session. Current metadata edited after capture may not retroactively validate old pixels.

sourceBundle.bundleDigest: SHA-256(path + LF + lowercase_file_sha256 + LF, repeated in canonical order)

temporalRule: Every bound source file must have lastWriteUtc no later than render receipt sealedUtc plus a 2-second filesystem-clock tolerance. A metadata file written after capture cannot be bound to old pixels.

runtimeBehavior.postImportMutationBehavior: remove authoritative render_capture_receipt.json and binding receipt; preserve PNGs for diagnosis

failureInjection: edit any linked construction/material contract after capture
edit the persisted benchmark scene after capture
attempt to bind metadata whose filesystem write time is later than the render receipt seal
delete a source that was present in the bound metadata bundle
change coverage contractPaths so the bound source set differs
expectedFailure: The authoritative render receipt is invalidated fail-closed. Existing rendered PNGs remain available for diagnosis but cannot reach the evidence-bound Visual Fidelity gate until a fresh Unity capture is made.
